feature_schema_canonical.note: Some KEEPs use sq=[40,40,15] (Scratching) — their pkls declare the exact extraction config.

tiers.Tier 2 (BOUT_USEFUL): frame F1 < 0.85 BUT bout F1 >= 0.5 AND bout-count Pearson r >= 0.7. Use when bout counts/durations matter more than per-frame accuracy.
tiers.Tier 3 (BELOW_GATE): Below both gates. Shipped for completeness, marked experimental. Not recommended for production analyses.

classifiers.name: Scratching
classifiers.definition: Mouse rapidly scratches with a hindpaw, typically targeting head/neck/back.
classifiers.note: 2026-08-23: retrained with the standard extraction settings (pix 0.3, squares [40,40,40], flow on) so Scratching shares the 8aed1c22 feature-cache group with the rest of the Core 8. frame_f1 is now HONEST session-level GroupKFold CV (0.739 ± 0.082); the previous 0.952 ± 0.003 was frame-level CV, which leaks adjacent frames of the same bout and inflates F1. The old features scored 0.720 ± 0.128 under the same honest protocol, so the settings change costs nothing. v1 artifact: superseded/classifier_Scratching_v1_oldsettings_20260823.pkl

classifiers.name: Left_licking
classifiers.definition: Mouse licks its left hindpaw (pain/itch response).

classifiers.name: Facial_grooming
classifiers.definition: Mouse grooms the face with one or both forepaws.
classifiers.suppression_note: Trained on 260506_RS_THC_Withdrawal, which has no hind-paw licking; from below, a mouse curled over its hind paw scores as face grooming with p~0.96. Frames where Left_licking fires are zeroed before bout filtering when the batch applies exclusion rules.

classifiers.name: jump
classifiers.note: naloxone-precipitated withdrawal readout; trained on the AOW cohort with S6 held out; analysed as discrete events, not a mutually exclusive state

classifiers.name: rearing
classifiers.definition: Mouse stands on its hindpaws, forepaws lifted (supported or unsupported).

classifiers.name: moving
classifiers.definition: Mouse moving through the arena (walking or running).

classifiers.name: still
classifiers.definition: Mouse not moving (no locomotion, rearing or grooming).

classifiers.name: body_grooming
classifiers.definition: Mouse grooms torso/back/belly area with forepaws or by twisting around.
classifiers.note: v2 rebuild excluding unreviewed frames; original in superseded/
classifiers.suppression_note: Trained on uninjured baseline sessions (260318_JG), which have no hind-paw licking; a mouse twisted around to lick its hind paw can score as body grooming. Frames where Left_licking fires are zeroed before bout filtering when the batch applies exclusion rules.

changelog_1_1_0: rearing and body_grooming now point at the v2 rebuilds the manuscript deploys (originals in superseded/: rearing shipped min_bout=1, body_grooming trained on 83,640 unreviewed frames as negatives). Scratching operating point corrected to the deployed 0.5/3/10 recipe (stored 0.86/1/0 accepted 17 ms bouts; original in superseded/). classifier_jump added -- the naloxone-withdrawal readout, trained on the AOW cohort with session S6 held out. L_flinching withheld from this distribution (superseded/).
priority_note: Highest first; the same order the Multi-Classifier and Sequencing tabs resolve states in. With exclusion rules on (the default), the batch zeroes each behavior on frames where a behavior above it fired, before bout filtering and in the final calls, so a frame keeps only its highest-priority call and every behavior's total adds up with the others.

changes: priority_order: every Core 8 behavior is overridden by the ones ranked above it (licking > scratching > jump > rearing > body grooming > facial grooming > moving > still). Raw calls overlapped on 4.7% of frames across 27 one-hour formalin sessions (still & moving 113k frames, rearing & moving 28k, scratching & moving 70% of scratching frames).
walking renamed moving: classifier_moving.pkl (same model), docs/moving.md, performance_results/moving/.

body_grooming: suppressed_by=[Left_licking]. On the example project, body grooming was called on 55 and 66 licking frames of two vehicle formalin mice (9% and 30% of their body-grooming frames); the classifier was trained on baseline sessions with no hind-paw licking.

Facial_grooming: suppressed_by=[Left_licking]. In the example project 91% of facial-grooming frames of a vehicle formalin mouse fell inside licking bouts (grooming p median 0.96, above the 0.85 threshold). The batch zeroes a suppressed behavior on frames where the overriding behavior fired (opt-out checkbox on Run Classifiers).

classifier_Scratching.pkl: corrected include_optical_flow False->True (model requires hrpaw/hlpaw/snout Flow features; extraction config was self-contradictory and batch prediction failed). Pre-fix copy in superseded/.
